items.title: Charlie Hardy Interview, 1961-12-16
items.q: I think I have heard the Memphis Five, yes. ... Phil Napoleon, and something like Miss Maul, who played with him.

ctx.x: I think I have heard the Memphis Five, yes. Yeah. Either on a record or someplace or someplace.
